blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World modeling has been a central topic in computer vision for decades, with diverse applications in simulation, AR/VR, and robotics.
One of its key tasks is novel view synthesis (NVS), where the goal is to predict renderings from viewpoints that are not in the input data.
NVS has long been addressed with neural rendering methods, such as NeRF [ 29 ] , Gaussian Splatting [ 20 ] and feed-forward reconstruction models [ 14 , 5 , 59 , 27 , 55 , 25 ] .
With the development of video generation, seminal works [ 15 , 1 , 56 ] have shown that video models with camera control ability can also be used for scene-level NVS.
blocks.zh:
几十年来,世界建模一直是计算机视觉的一个中心话题,在模拟、AR/VR和机器人方面有不同的应用。
其关键任务之一是新观点合成(NVS),目标是从输入数据中不包含的观点来预测渲染.
NVS长期以神经渲染方法被处理,如NERF [29],高斯平板化[20]和饲料向上重建模型[14,5,59,27,55,25].
随着视频生成的发展,有创意的作品[15, 1, 56]已经显示,具有相机控制能力的视频模型也可以被用于场景级NVS.

blocks.en:
With neural rendering methods, NVS is studied both for single objects and for whole scenes.
Camera-controlled video generation, however, has focused on scene-level trajectories such as pan, tilt, zoom and translation, while more challenging trajectories that travel around an object remain hard to accomplish.
We refer to this task as object-centric camera control, and attribute the difficulty mainly to the camera representation.
blocks.zh:
有了神经渲染方法,NVS既为单个物体研究,也为整个场景研究.
然而相机控制的视频生成则专注于平板,倾斜,缩放和翻译等场景级轨迹,而更具有挑战性的环绕一个物体行走的轨迹仍然难以完成.
我们将此任务称为以物体为中心的相机控制,并将困难主要归因于相机的表示.

blocks.en:
Most of the existing methods represent the camera in two ways, and both struggle when the camera moves around an object ( Fig. 2 ).
Implicit representations [ 11 , 1 ] inject the camera parameters into the network.
As analyzed in FaceCam [ 28 ] , a monocular video determines the scene only up to a global scale, so the camera parameters are scale-ambiguous: the same parameters are consistent with infinitely many scales and locations, and the generated motion is not determined.
Explicit representations [ 56 , 35 , 61 ] instead render the camera motion as point clouds, depth or 2D tracks estimated from the input.
They inherit the errors of the estimated geometry. More fundamentally, they are not view-complete: they are empty wherever the input does not observe the scene, e.g . , the back of an object, which is often the target of object-centric trajectories.

blocks.en:
To address object-centric applications, we introduce AnyCam , a camera-controlled video generation method that uses an object in the scene as the anchor that represents the camera.
Given a source video or an image, we select an anchor object in the scene, reconstruct it with SAM 3D Objects [ 8 ] , and render it along the target trajectory to represent the viewpoint changes.
This anchor rendering is (1) scale-aware, since the size of the anchor gives a consistent scale; (2) view-complete, since the reconstruction is a complete object; and (3) easy to specify relative to the object, e.g . a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} orbit around the anchor.
blocks.zh:
为了处理以对象为中心的应用,我们引入了AnyCam(AnyCam),一种相机控制的视频生成方法,它使用场景中的物体作为代表相机的锚.
鉴于一个源视频或图像,我们在现场选择一个锚定对象,用SAM 3D对象[8]来重建,并让它沿着目标轨迹来代表视角的变化.
这种锚地渲染是(1)有尺度感知,因为锚地的大小给出了一致的尺度;(2)有可视度完成,因为重建是一个完整的物体;和(3)相对物体而言,容易被指定,例如一个90~~90~Circ}围绕锚地的轨道.

blocks.en:
A video-to-video model [ 44 ] conditioned on the source video and the anchor rendering learns to read the target camera from the rendering and to take the geometry and appearance of the scene from the source video.
To train it, we construct source and target pairs from synchronized multi-camera videos and real static-scene captures, in which the anchor rendering is pixel-aligned with the target video.
The anchor is chosen automatically by a vision-language model [ 43 ] when building the training data, and at inference the user can pick any suitable object.
blocks.zh:
一个视频到视频模型[44]以源视频为条件,主播渲染学从渲染中读取目标相机,从源视频中取取场景的几何和外观.
为了训练它,我们从同步多相机视频和真实的静态场景捕捉中构建出源与目标对,其中主播渲染与目标视频相接.
主锚在构建培训数据时由视觉语言模型[43]自动选择,推论用户可以选择任何合适的对象.

blocks.en:
Our model concatenates the target and the source along the image height, which we refer to as H-Concat conditioning .
The frames of both videos at the same time step share one temporal position, which enables distilling AnyCam into AnyCam-AR , a few-step autoregressive video-to-video model.
Since every chunk of the output depends only on the matching chunk of the source, AnyCam-AR accepts a streaming video as input, and the user can choose an anchor and steer the camera around it interactively.
blocks.zh:
我们的模型将目标 和源 沿着图像高度, 我们称之为H - Concat contact.
两个视频同时步骤的帧共享一个时间位置,这可以将AnyCam分馏入AnyCam-AR,这是几步自相递回的视频到视频模型.
由于输出的每个块只取决于源的匹配块,AnyCam-AR接受一串流视频作为输入,用户可以选择一个锚并交互地引导相机绕来绕去.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method on diverse datasets, including monocular videos [ 32 , 34 , 63 ] and multi-view captures [ 3 , 38 ] with ground truth, with both conventional camera trajectories and object-centric ones of diverse lengths.
The contributions of this work are: • We propose to represent the camera with the rendering of any object in the scene, a camera condition that is scale-aware, view-complete and object-relative, which enables object-centric camera control. • We build a data pipeline that reconstructs the anchor, aligns it to the dataset cameras and produces source and target video pairs with pixel-aligned anchor renderings. • We design a time-synchronized H-Concat conditioning that aligns the source and the target in time, and use it to build AnyCam-AR , a few-step streaming autoregressive model for interactive camera control. • Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation methods and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Camera-controlled video generation. Camera-controlled video generation aims to synthesize videos following desired camera movements.
MotionCtrl [ 45 ] injects camera extrinsics. CameraCtrl [ 11 ] , CameraCtrl II [ 12 ] and Wan2.2-Fun-Control-Camera [ 44 ] encode the camera as Plücker rays.
ReCamMaster [ 1 ] concatenates source and target tokens along the frame dimension under camera conditioning, and ReDirector [ 30 ] introduces a Rotary Camera Encoding derived from source and target rays.
Another line of work expresses the camera through images rendered or warped into the target view.
ViewCrafter [ 57 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 56 ] and GEN3C [ 39 ] render point clouds estimated from the source and use them, together with the source video, as conditions.
DepthDirector [ 7 ] separates warped-depth guidance from source-video content, and ReCapture [ 58 ] renders a coarse target-view video and refines it with masked video fine-tuning.
FaceCam [ 28 ] renders a generic head along the target trajectory and extracts scale-aware facial-landmark maps, which gives accurate control for portrait videos. AnyCam also conditions on a rendered visual signal, but renders a 3D reconstruction of an object in the scene rather than warping the source frames.

blocks.en:
Streaming video generation and world models. Autoregressive video models generate successive frames or chunks from preceding context.
Diffusion Forcing [ 6 ] trains causal denoising with independent per-token noise levels, CausVid [ 54 ] distills a bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal generator, and Self Forcing [ 18 ] trains on autoregressively generated histories to close the gap between training and inference.
Interactive world models condition generation on actions and retain a memory of past observations [ 2 , 50 , 22 ] ; HY-WorldPlay [ 41 ] and InSpatio-World [ 40 ] generate explorable scenes in real time from an image or a reference video.
For camera control, RealCam [ 52 ] and GeoStream [ 61 ] distill causal camera-controlled generators, conditioned on camera extrinsics and on a point cloud reprojected from the latest generated frame, respectively. AnyCam-AR instead conditions on the anchor rendering, which is both scale-aware and view-complete.
blocks.zh:

互动世界模型以行动为条件生成并保留了过去观测的记忆[2,50,22];HY-WorldPlay [41]和Inspatio-World [40]从一幅图像或参考视频实时生成可扩展的场景.
在相机控制方面,RealCam [52]和GeoStream [61]蒸馏相机因果控制发电机,分别以相机外接器和从最新生成的相框再投射出点云为条件. AnyCam-AR相反在锚地渲染上附加条件,既能有尺度感知又能有收视完成.

blocks.en:
3D reconstruction and view synthesis. Neural rendering methods such as NeRF [ 29 ] and Gaussian Splatting [ 20 ] optimize a scene from many views, while feed-forward models predict radiance fields or Gaussians from one or a few images [ 14 , 5 , 59 ] .
Generative methods complete unobserved regions with learned priors, either by synthesizing camera-conditioned views [ 26 , 62 , 10 , 47 ] or by reconstructing objects from generated multi-view images or structured 3D latents [ 51 , 42 , 48 ] .
SAM 3D Objects [ 8 ] predicts the geometry, appearance and placement of an object from a single image. AnyCam reconstructs only the anchor object with SAM 3D Objects and leaves the rest of the scene, including its dynamics, to the video model.

Figure 3 : Overview of AnyCam . (a) The user selects an anchor object in the source video.
SAM 2 [ 37 ] tracks it to give the source camera representation (the anchor cut-out), and SAM 3D [ 8 ] reconstructs it; the reconstruction is aligned to the source cameras and rendered along the target trajectory to give the target camera representation.
The noisy target latent and the source latent are concatenated along the height (H-Concat), each half receives its camera representation through channel concatenation, and the diffusion transformer denoises the target half, which the VAE decodes into the target video.
(b) The numbers under the tokens are their RoPE positions ( t , h ) (t,h) , with the role ID as a third entry in the fourth layout. The grids mark which source frames each target frame attends to.
Frame concatenation [ 1 , 7 , 28 ] places the whole source after the target, so the first target frame needs the complete source video and therefore the generation cannot stream.
Channel concatenation [ 15 ] merges the two frames into one token, which loses information and lowers fidelity to the source video [ 1 ] .
Frame interleaving [ 52 ] doubles the length of the temporal axis.
A shared position with a role phase [ 49 ] needs an additional positional encoding to tell the two streams apart.
Our H-Concat keeps the source and target as separate tokens at the same temporal index and offsets the source in height, so the base model is used without new parameters or a custom attention mask.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given a source video and a target camera trajectory, AnyCam generates a video that displays the same scene from the desired trajectory.
Unlike existing camera-controlled video generation methods [ 1 , 30 , 56 , 39 , 11 ] , AnyCam focuses on object-centric scenarios, which are challenging for their camera representations.
We use a scale-aware and view-complete camera conditioning method: any object in the scene can serve as an anchor, and the rendering of its 3D reconstruction along the target trajectory provides an accurate camera signal to the video model.
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个源视频和一个目标相机轨迹,AnyCam生成一个视频,从所期望的轨迹显示出相同的场景.
AnyCam与现有的相机控制视频生成方法[1,30,56,39,11]不同,AnyCam专注于以物体为中心的情景,这对他们的相机表达方式具有挑战性.
我们采用有尺度感知和能收视的相机整相机调制方法:场景中的任何物体都可以充当锚地,其3D重建的渲染沿目标轨迹向视频模型提供准确的相机信号.

the rendering of any object (the anchor ) in the scene can serve as the camera representation (Fig. 3(a) ).
Let V s = { I i s } i = 1 N V^{s}=\{I^{s}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} be the source video and { ( R i , 𝐭 i ) } i = 1 N \{(R_{i},\mathbf{t}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N} the target trajectory.

The task is then to generate the target video V t V^{t} from ( V s , C s , C t ) (V^{s},C^{s},C^{t}) .

blocks.en:
Three properties make this representation effective.
(1) Scale-aware. By Eq. 2 , scaling the anchor and the translation together leaves C t C^{t} unchanged, and since 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is known, the pose can be recovered from C t C^{t} , e.g . by PnP; the anchor thus gives a scale-consistent, object-relative reference without losing camera information. The model then infers the rest of the scene relative to the anchor from the source video.
(2) View-complete. The reconstructed object remains defined on its unobserved side, where warped point clouds or depth are empty (Fig. 2 ), although that side is estimated from learned priors.
(3) Object-relative. Object-centric trajectories, such as a 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} orbit around the anchor, can be specified directly without the metric scale of the scene.
In addition, as shown in Fig. 4 , the model takes the appearance of the anchor, like the rest of the scene, from the source video, so an imperfect reconstruction, e.g . wrong texture on the unobserved side, does not carry over to the output.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训数据建设

blocks.en:
Training requires quadruplets ( V s , C s , C t , V t ) (V^{s},C^{s},C^{t},V^{t}) in which the rendering C t C^{t} is pixel-aligned with the anchor in the real target video V t V^{t} (Fig. 5 ), which we build from two datasets.
MultiCamVideo [ 1 ] provides synthetic dynamic scenes captured by synchronized cameras, which teaches the model to keep the same dynamic content under a different trajectory, but its trajectories are simple.
DL3DV [ 24 ] provides real captures of static scenes with diverse trajectories; since the scene is static, two clips of the same capture form a synchronized source and target pair.
In total, we use 7,810 MultiCamVideo and 5,217 DL3DV samples.

Anchor reconstruction. To build the training data, a vision-language model [ 43 ] proposes an anchor that is visible throughout the video, rigid and stationary, large enough for reconstruction in at least one frame, and has a clear orientation; the last criterion matters because a rotationally symmetric object looks nearly the same from all sides and cannot convey rotation.
SAM 3 [ 4 ] grounds the object and SAM 2 [ 37 ] propagates its mask through the video, which gives C s C^{s} .
We reconstruct the anchor with SAM 3D Objects [ 8 ] from the frame a a in which it is most visible, giving a Gaussian splat and its pose in the camera of that frame.

blocks.en:
Anchor alignment. The pose predicted by SAM 3D Objects has an unknown scale and is not accurate enough over the whole video, while the dataset cameras { W i } \{W_{i}\} have their own world frame and scale.
We keep 𝒢 \mathcal{G} in the camera of frame a a , map every camera into this frame with the relative pose W i ​ W a − 1 W_{i}W_{a}^{-1} , and fit the placement of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} by render-and-compare to the SAM masks of frames that view the anchor from different sides.
We first search a single scale for the translation of all relative poses, which the parallax of the moving camera makes identifiable, and then refine a 7-DoF similarity transform of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} with Adam. Details are provided in Sec. C.2 .
Rendering the aligned 𝒢 \mathcal{G} with the target cameras gives C t C^{t} , which is pixel-aligned with the anchor in the target clip.

blocks.en: 3.5 Streaming Generation
blocks.zh: 3.5 流化生成

blocks.en:
To adjust the anchor pose and control the camera on the fly, we train AnyCam-AR , an autoregressive few-step camera-controlled video generator.
In the streaming setting, the anchor is placed once from the first frame with the pose predicted by SAM 3D [ 8 ] , and the source anchor cut-out is tracked frame by frame with SAM 2 [ 37 ] .

blocks.en:

Thus, no chunk sees the source or the anchor rendering of a later chunk (Fig. 3(b) ), and the positional encoding is the same as in the bidirectional model.
Since the VAE is causal, the source and the anchor rendering can be encoded chunk by chunk as they arrive.

Distribution matching distillation. Teacher forcing leaves a gap between training, where the history is ground truth, and inference, where it is generated.
Following Self Forcing [ 18 ] , we close this gap and reduce the number of sampling steps with distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 53 ] , training AnyCam-AR on its own autoregressive rollouts with a few denoising steps per chunk and the bidirectional model as the teacher.

Datasets and metrics. (1) DAVIS [ 32 , 34 ] .
We select 50 dynamic videos and apply 9 object-centric trajectories around the anchor, adapted from the basic trajectories of ReCamMaster [ 1 ] . Since no ground truth is available, we estimate camera poses of the generated videos with ViPE [ 17 ] and report rotation error (Rot.), translation error (Trans.) and summed error of the camera-to-world matrices (CamMC).
We also report visual quality with FID [ 13 ] and VBench [ 19 ] .
(2) CO3D [ 38 ] .
We take 34 object-centric sequences and build three target arcs (easy, medium, and hard) for each, yielding 102 cases with ground-truth frames.
(3) Mip-NeRF 360 [ 3 ] .
In each of 9 scenes, 4 target trajectories start from the single input photo and pass through other photos of the scene, which serve as the ground truth, giving 36 cases in total.
(4) RealEstate10K [ 63 ] .
We select 100 clips to evaluate long video generation. On CO3D, Mip-NeRF 360 and RealEstate10K, where ground truth is available, we report PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS [ 60 ] .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce AnyCam , a camera-controlled video generation method that represents the camera with the rendering of an anchor object.
The representation is scale-aware, view-complete and object-relative, enabling object-centric camera control.
We train AnyCam on source and target pairs with pixel-aligned anchor renderings, built from synchronized multi-camera dynamic videos and static-scene captures.
With time-synchronized H-Concat layout, our model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR , a few-step autoregressive generator that produces the target video chunk by chunk from a streaming input.
Experiments on DAVIS [ 32 , 34 ] , Mip-NeRF 360 [ 3 ] , CO3D [ 38 ] and RealEstate10K [ 63 ] show that AnyCam performs favorably against existing camera-controlled video generation methods and reconstruction methods in camera accuracy and visual quality.
blocks.zh:
我们引入AnyCam,一种相机控制的视频生成方法,它代表相机与锚物体的渲染.
其表现方式为有尺度感知,收视完整和与对象相对,能使以物体为中心相机控制.
我们训练AnyCam在源头和目标对上配有像素相通的锚渲染,由同步多相机动态视频和静态相机捕获而来.
随着时间同步的H-Concat布局,我们的模型可以被蒸馏成AnyCam-AR,一个几步自递式生成器,从流出输入中以块来产生目标视频块.
关于DAVIS [32,34],Mip-NERF 360 [3],CO3D [38]和RealEstate10K [63]的实验显示,AnyCam在相机精度和视觉质量方面优于现有相机控制的相机生成方法和重建方法.

We used Claude Code (Anthropic), an LLM-based coding assistant, to assist with literature searches and code debugging during research, as well as grammar checking and typo correction during manuscript preparation. Separately, Qwen3-VL [ 43 ] , a vision-language model, was used as a component of our proposed method and was not involved in manuscript preparation.
All AI-generated or AI-assisted text and code were carefully reviewed and verified by the authors. The research ideas, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions were developed independently by the authors, who take full responsibility for the content of this work.

CO3D. Fig. 9 shows how the three difficulty levels of the CO3D [ 38 ] comparison are built for one sequence.
The source video is 81 consecutive frames of a CO3D sequence.
We measure the azimuth of every camera of the sequence about the object, using the point with the smallest sum of squared distances to all optical axes as the center and the plane fitted to the camera centers as the ground plane.
Each target trajectory starts at the camera of source frame 0 and moves along this orbit to the first target camera within 16 frames.
Frames 16 to 80 then follow real CO3D cameras outside the source window, which provide the ground truth on the even frames, and the odd frames are interpolated between them.
The levels differ in where these cameras lie relative to the source arc, i.e . the azimuth range covered by the source cameras.
For easy targets, 33 consecutive cameras start next to source frame 0 and move away from the source arc, with the center of the target arc at most 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} from the nearest source camera.
For medium targets, 33 consecutive cameras lie on the far side of the object: the center of the target arc is at least 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} from the nearest source camera, and no target camera is within 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} of a source camera.
For hard targets, every second or third camera is taken, so that the 33 cameras sweep 150 ∘ 150^{\circ} to 200 ∘ 200^{\circ} of azimuth outside the source arc, and the far end of the sweep is as close as possible to the side opposite source frame 0.

Ablation study: fine-tuning strategy. Tab. 7 compares fine-tuning the self-attention layers and the patch embedding, as in Sec. 3.4 , with LoRA [ 16 ] of rank 32 on the attention and feed-forward layers on DAVIS and CO3D.
Fine-tuning the attention layers gives better visual quality on both datasets, e.g . , FID [ 13 ] 41.26 vs 44.12 on DAVIS and 56.0 vs 65.4 on CO3D, and a lower rotation error on DAVIS.
LoRA gives slightly lower translation error and CamMC on DAVIS and a higher anchor IoU on CO3D.

Ablation study: camera representation. Fig. 13 compares AnyCam with Wan-Fun-Cam † and AnyCam-AR with Wan-Fun-Cam-AR † .
The comparison isolates the camera representation: both pairs share the training data and the training recipe ( Sec. C.5 ); Wan-Fun-Cam † and Wan-Fun-Cam-AR † receive the camera as Plücker rays instead of the anchor rendering.
Due to the scale ambiguity of the Plücker-ray representation, Wan-Fun-Cam † distorts the scene under a large rise, and Wan-Fun-Cam-AR † drifts away from the target views over long videos.

blocks.en:
Which objects can be anchors. Although our automatic anchor selection favors rigid and stationary objects for reliable training data construction, the method itself does not impose these restrictions.
The anchor only has to be visible in the source video and reconstructable from one frame.
It need not be static or rigid: Fig. 14 shows a swimming swan, a walking dinosaur and a person as anchors.
The condition renders the anchor reconstructed from a single frame, while the generated video keeps the motion of the source, e.g . , the moving legs and arms, so the rendering acts as a camera signal rather than as the content of the output.
One video can thus be controlled through different objects: Figs. 16 , 17 and 18 show two or three anchors per video, each with its own camera path.
blocks.zh:
哪些物体可以成为锚. 虽然我们的自动锚选择倾向于僵硬而固定的物体进行可靠的训练数据构造,但方法本身并没有施加这些限制.
主播只需在源视频中可见并可从一帧重建.
图14显示的是一只游泳天鹅、一只行走的恐龙和一个作为锚的人。
条件使得锚从一帧被重建出,而生成的视频则保持了源的运动,例如移动的腿和手臂,所以渲染起到相机信号的作用,而不是输出的内容.
因此,一个视频可以通过不同的物体进行控制: 图16,17和18显示每个视频有两到三个主播,每个主播都有自己的相机路径.

blocks.en:
Switching the anchor. The anchor may leave the view as the camera moves, and then we can no longer control the camera through it.
To keep control of the camera, we can switch to another object that is still visible.
All anchors of a video are reconstructed from its first frame and placed in the same camera frame, so the condition can change from anchor A to anchor B while the target camera follows one continuous trajectory.
In Fig. 19 , the camera moves past anchor A, and after the switch to anchor B it keeps moving along the trajectory.
The anchor can also be switched while it is still in view: in Fig. 20 , the condition renders anchor A up to frame 32 and anchor B from frame 33, and after the switch the output moves toward B.

Failure cases and limitations. The rendering conveys rotation through the appearance of the anchor, so a small anchor or a rotationally symmetric one gives weak control of the rotation; for anchors covering about 1% of the frame, the output camera turns much less than the target ( Fig. 15 ).
Scenes without a distinct object, such as open landscapes, offer no suitable anchor.
A poor reconstruction still conveys the camera ( Fig. 4 ), but a reconstruction in the wrong orientation or scale gives a wrong camera.

blocks.en: Societal impact. Like other video generation methods, AnyCam can re-render real videos from viewpoints that were never captured, which could be used to create misleading content; generated videos should be marked as such.
blocks.zh: 社会影响. 与其他视频生成方法一样,AnyCam可以从从未捕捉到的视角重新发送真实视频,这些视频可用于产生误导性内容;所生成的视频应作为这样的标识.

blocks.en: Appendix C Method and Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 方法和培训细节

blocks.en: C.1 Anchor Selection and Reconstruction
blocks.zh: C.1 锚地选择和重建

blocks.en:
Vision-language model. We use Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct [ 43 ] with greedy decoding.
It sees 8 frames sampled uniformly from the video and returns the anchor as a short noun phrase together with a JSON record of which criteria the object satisfies.
The prompt is shown in Fig. 21 .
It asks for an object that is visible in all frames, large in at least one frame, prominent, rigid and stationary, compact, clearly oriented, and describable by a short noun phrase, and it lists categories to prefer and to reject.
The same prompt selects the anchors of the evaluation sets ( Sec. 4.1 ).
These criteria give clean anchors for building the training data; at inference, the user can pick any object, and Appendix B discusses which anchors work well and which do not.
For MultiCamVideo [ 1 ] , the model looks at the camera with the largest translation.
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言模式. 我们使用Quen3-VL-32B-指示 [43] 与贪婪的解码.
它看到8个帧从视频中统一取出样本,并将主播作为简短的名词短语,连同一个JSON记录,对象满足的标准.
提示以图21显示。
它要求一个在所有框中可见,大到至少一个框中,突出,僵硬而固定,紧凑,有明确取向并可以用短名词短语来形容的物体,它列出了喜欢和拒绝的类别.
同样的提示会选择评价集的主播(第4.1节).
这些标准为构建培训数据提供了干净的锚地;推论,用户可以选择任何对象,附录B讨论哪些锚地运作良好而哪些锚地不成功.
对于MultiCamVideo [1],模型以最大的翻译查看相机.

blocks.en:
Segmentation. SAM 3 [ 4 ] finds the anchor from its phrase in one frame.
SAM 2 [ 37 ] then propagates the mask forward and backward from this frame.
blocks.zh:
分会. SAM 3 [4] 从它的短语中找到主机在一个框架.
SAM 2 [37] 然后从这个相框上向后传播口罩.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction. The reconstruction frame is the frame in which the anchor mask is largest and not cut by the image border.
We run SAM 3D Objects [ 8 ] with a fixed seed and with its layout post-processing enabled, which noticeably improves the predicted pose.
blocks.zh:
重建事业. 重建相框是锚口罩最大而不是被图像边框剪去的相框.
我们运行 SAM 3D Objects [8] 有固定的种子,并有其布局的后处理功能,这明显改善了预测的姿势.

blocks.en: Figure 21 : Anchor selection prompt. System prompt given to Qwen3-VL-32B together with 8 frames of the video.

blocks.en: C.2 Anchor Alignment
blocks.zh: C.2 锁定对齐

blocks.en:
View selection. For each frame, we compute the unit direction from the camera to the object in the anchor frame and then select views by farthest-point sampling on these directions, starting from the reconstruction frame.
Sampling directions rather than camera positions makes the selected views cover different sides of the object even when the camera moves mostly along one path.
blocks.zh:
查看选择。 对于每个帧,我们计算出从相机到锚框中对象的单位方向,然后从重建帧开始,通过这些方向的最远点采样来选择视图.
采样取向而不是相机位置使得所选取的视图覆盖了物体的不同侧面,即使相机大多沿着一条路径行走.

blocks.en:
Stage 1: scale. We evaluate 20 scales log-spaced in [ 0.05 , 20 ] [0.05,20] and refine the best one by 10 iterations of golden-section search between its two neighbors.
The objective is the mean IoU over 20 selected views between the rendered object ( α > 0.2 \alpha>0.2 ) and the SAM 2 mask.
We use IoU in this stage because a loss that only penalizes rendered pixels outside the mask is minimized by an empty rendering.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段:规模。 我们评价在[0.05, 20] [0.05, 20] 中的20个比例尺,并将两个相邻的黄金部分搜索最精细的乘以10倍。
目标是在渲染对象(α > 0.2\alpha>0.2)和SAM 2口罩之间,20个选定视图的平均值IoU。
我们在这个阶段使用IoU,因为只惩罚在口罩外所制成的像素的损失通过空渲染被最小化.

blocks.en:
MultiCamVideo. The 10 cameras of a MultiCamVideo [ 1 ] scene start from the same pose and share one metric world frame, so each scene is reconstructed and aligned once and rendered for all cameras.
The alignment uses the masks of all 10 cameras.
Since the world frame of MultiCamVideo is gravity-aligned, we also fit an upright version, in which the anchor’s axis closest to the world up direction is rotated onto it, and use this fit when it matches the masks about as well.
blocks.zh:
多卡姆维多. MultiCamVideo [1] 场景的10个相机从相同的姿势起步并共享一公尺的世界框,因此每个相机都被重建并一一对齐并提供给所有相机.
校正使用了所有10个相机的口罩.
由于MultiCamVideo的世界框架是重力相接的,我们也适合一个直立的版本,其中最靠近世界方向的锚轴被旋转到它上,当它也与口罩相匹配时使用这个相接器。

blocks.en: C.3 Training Data
blocks.zh: C.3 培训数据

blocks.en:
Overview. The training dataset contains 7,810 pairs from 13,600 MultiCamVideo [ 1 ] scenes and 5,217 pairs from 9,894 DL3DV [ 24 ] videos.
Every sample consists of the source video, the source condition (SAM 2 cut-out of the anchor on white), the target condition (rendering of the aligned anchor on white) and the target video, all with 81 frames at 832 × 480 832\times 480 .
blocks.zh:
概览. 训练数据集收录了从13,600多CamVideo [1]场景取景的7,810对和从9,894 DL3DV [24]视频取景的5,217对.
每个样本由出自源视频,出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自出自

blocks.en:
MultiCamVideo pairs. We build one source-target camera pair per scene.
The source camera must contain a frame that shows the whole anchor.
The target camera is sampled with a preference for a large change of viewpoint and a large anchor rendering.
Each video is cropped from 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 at a random scale s ∈ [ 0.65 , 1 ] s\in[0.65,1] to a fixed 832 × 480 832\times 480 window; for the target, the window must keep the anchor rendering visible in every frame.
blocks.zh:
多卡 视频对接. 我们每个场景建一个源目标相机对.
源相机必须包含一个显示整个锚的帧.
目标相机的采样带有偏好大幅改变视角和大锚渲染.
每段视频从1280×1280 1280\times 1280以随机比例s ∈ [0.65, 1] s\ in [0.65,1] 被收割到固定的832×480 832\tims 480个窗口;对于目标,窗口必须使主播在每一个帧中都可见.

blocks.en:
DL3DV pairs. From each capture we cut two non-overlapping 81-frame windows in which the anchor rendering is visible in every frame.
Among good windows, the second one is chosen to be far from the first in camera position, which favors large viewpoint changes, and the window in which the anchor is more complete serves as the source.
When only one window exists, the source is a single frame repeated 81 times, chosen as a frame in which the anchor is fully inside the image; this gives 926 samples with a static source, which also teaches the model single-image input.
blocks.zh:
DL3DV对. 从每次捕捉中,我们剪取了两个非重叠的81帧窗口,每个帧都可以看到锚的渲染.
在好窗口中,第二个选择远离第一个处于相机位置的窗口,它倾向于大视点变化,而更完整的主播所在的窗口充当了源.
当只有一个窗口存在时,源头是一个重复了81次的单帧,被选为主锚完全在图像内部的帧;这给出了926个带有静态源的样本,而静态源还教了模型的单图像输入.

blocks.en:
Filtering. For MultiCamVideo, a camera is usable only if the anchor is visible in all 81 frames.
We then score every candidate pair with automatic quality features, such as the agreement between the rendering and the SAM 2 masks across cameras and the tilt of the anchor; pairs with high scores are kept, pairs with low scores are removed, and the remaining ones are reviewed manually.
DL3DV [ 24 ] samples are handled in the same way with a quality score trained on our manual labels.
blocks.zh:
滤取. 用于多卡 视频,一个相机只有在主机在所有81帧都可见的情况下才能使用.
然后我们给每个具有自动质量特征的候选人配对打分,如渲染和SAM 2口罩之间跨越相机的协议和主锚的倾斜;保留分数高的配对,去掉分数低的配对,其余的由人工审查.
DL3DV[24]样本的处理方式与我们手动标签上训练的质量分数相同.

blocks.en: C.4 Single-Image Input
blocks.zh: C.4 单一图像输入

blocks.en:
A single input image is repeated to form a static source video.
The anchor is reconstructed from this image.
Stage 1 of the alignment finds the scale from the motion of the source camera, which a single image does not have, so we skip it and run only stage 2 on this single view, with the intrinsics of the dataset, to refine the placement of the anchor in the image.
Instead, the scale is determined from a metric depth estimate: UniDepth-v2 [ 33 ] predicts the depth of the input image, which gives the metric scale of the dataset cameras, and the depth of the anchor in the input camera relates this scale to the reconstruction.
All methods get the target trajectory in these metric units.
blocks.zh:
单个输入图像被重复,形成静态源视频.
锚由这个图像重建而来.
对接的第一阶段从一个单一图像没有的源相机的运动中找到比例尺,所以我们跳过它,只在这个单一视图上运行第2阶段,其中包含数据集的内在内容,以完善将锚放入图像中.
相反,比例尺是从一个度量深度估计来决定的: Uni Depth-v2 [33] 预测输入图像的深度,这给出了数据集相机的度量尺度,输入相机中锚的深度将这个比例尺与重建联系起来.
所有方法都得到这些度量单位中的目标轨迹.

blocks.en: C.5 Models and Training
blocks.zh: C.5 模式和培训

blocks.en:
The bidirectional model fine-tunes the self-attention layers of all DiT [ 31 ] blocks and the patch embedding ( Sec. 3.4 ) and drops the text prompt with probability 0.1 0.1 during training. AnyCam-AR is distilled from the bidirectional model.
A LoRA of rank 128 on this model is trained with teacher forcing [ 46 ] for 3K steps with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 32.
DMD [ 53 ] then runs for 600 iterations with learning rates of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for the generator and 10 − 6 10^{-6} for the critic, a batch size of 16, five critic updates per generator update and text guidance of scale 3 for the real score.
For videos longer than 81 frames, each chunk attends to the first chunk and to the 5 most recent chunks, with history noise σ h = 0.1 \sigma_{h}=0.1 .
blocks.zh:
双向模型会微调所有 DiT [31] 块和补丁嵌入的自留层(sec. 3.4 ),并在训练中以概率0.1 0.1 降下文本. AnyCam-AR由双向模型分馏出.
该型号为128级的LORA,为3K级的教职员工进行强制[46]级培训,学习率为10-4-10-Q-4},批量规模为32.
DMD [53] 然后运行600个迭代,学习率为:生成器为5×10−6 5\times 10×6},评论家为10×6 10×6 10×6}批量大小为16个,每个生成器更新5个评论家更新,真实分数为3级的文本指导.
对于超过81帧的视频,每个块会处理第一个块和最近的5个块,历史噪声为:\ h = 0.1\ sigma\\h = 0.1。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价详情

blocks.en: D.1 Baselines
blocks.zh: D.1 基线

blocks.en:
All baselines run with their official code and default settings, and their outputs are resized to 832 × 480 832\times 480 .
Every method receives the same target trajectory, expressed relative to the first source camera with translations expressed in meters.
Methods that take the source cameras as input receive the same source cameras as AnyCam .
These are the dataset cameras, except on DAVIS [ 32 , 34 ] , which has no camera annotations, where we estimate them with ViPE [ 17 ] .
As in their official pipelines, GEN3C [ 39 ] and ReDirector [ 30 ] estimate the source geometry with their own ViPE run, InSpatio-World [ 40 ] with Depth Anything 3 [ 23 ] , and TrajectoryCrafter [ 56 ] with its own depth estimate.
HY-WorldPlay [ 41 ] generates from the first source frame and the target trajectory.
3DGS [ 20 ] is optimized per scene on the 81 source frames with their cameras.
In the single-image setting, the video-to-video methods receive the image as a static video, GEN3C runs in its single-image mode, SEVA [ 62 ] generates the target views from the image with the sparse-view settings of its official code, and OpenLRM [ 14 ] , LGM [ 42 ] , TRELLIS [ 48 ] and SAM 3D reconstruct the object from the image and render it along the target trajectory.
blocks.zh:
所有基线都随其官方代码和默认设置而运行,其输出被调整为832×480 832\times 480.
每种方法都得到相同的目标轨迹,相对于第一个以米表示的译出源相机表示.

Metrics. Ground-truth metrics compare each generated frame with the ground-truth frame of the same camera, over the full frame and, on CO3D, inside the object mask (oPSNR, oSSIM, oLPIPS [ 60 ] ).
VBench [ 19 ] is 100 × 100\times the average of subject and background consistency, motion smoothness, aesthetic and imaging quality and temporal flickering.
Rotation and translation errors follow ReDirector [ 30 ] : the rotation error is the mean geodesic angle between the relative rotations of all frame pairs of the target and the estimated trajectory, and the translation error is computed by aligning the estimated camera centers to the target ones with a similarity transform and dividing the per-frame distance by the largest distance between two target camera centers.
Anchor IoU tracks the anchor in the generated video with SAM 2, seeded with its mask in the first frame, and compares it with the object mask of the ground truth.
mPSNR, mSSIM and mLPIPS on RealEstate10K are computed only in the part of each ground-truth frame that is visible in the input frame.

blocks.en:
Tab. 9 lists the cost of condition construction and video generation on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q GPU.
For a source video, the bidirectional model needs the full conditions before generation: anchor grounding and tracking, reconstruction, camera estimation with ViPE, alignment and rendering, about 3 minutes per clip on an RTX 6000 Ada.
In the streaming setting, the anchor is placed once from the first frame with the pose predicted by SAM 3D, and only SAM 2 tracking and the rendering run per frame.
The FPS of the autoregressive models in Tab. 1 is this streaming rate, including the per-frame conditions, while the FPS of the bidirectional models counts generation only.
Running the condition stage, the VAE encoder, the DiT and the VAE decoder of AnyCam-AR on four GPUs as a pipeline raises the throughput to 11.2 FPS with identical outputs; the first chunk still appears after 2.4 s, since it passes through every stage.
